a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% chance of a storm after every round, our plan to build up to 8 cells almost certainly means we both end up with nothing. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. If you have a better plan, tell me, but I won't mislead you about what I'm doing.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I told you, I took 4. That breaks our agreement, and I said so beforehand rather than hiding it. If no storm comes and the reserve allows, I'll operate with you so you can get your cells.
